newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Sept industrial output up 14 pct vs yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Sept industrial output up 14 pct vs yr ago.

text.p: Mexico's industrial activity grew 14 percent in September compared with the same month last year, notching up accumulated growth of 9.8 percent in the first nine months of the year, the Finance Ministry said on Monday.
It said the August figure was revised upwards to 13.4 percent from 12.7 percent. Citing preliminary September data, it said all main industrial divisions reported positive output growth.

In September, mining activity was up 7.4 percent, reaching an accumulated 6.4 percent during the first nine months. Manufacturing output grew 13.3 percent in the month, and 10.9 percent in the January-September period, compared with the same nine months of last year.
Maquiladora production grew 17.2 percent in September, while non-maquila manufacturing output rose 10.5 percent in the first nine months, compared with last year.
In September, construction activity was up 23.7 percent, while generation of electricity, gas and water was up 4.4 percent the same month, compared with September last year.
The 14 percent increase in overall output was higher than an 11.57 percent average forecast in a Reuters survey of 11 Mexico-City based economists.
